# The Equinox, Volume I, Numbers 1–10

Read ../observatory-source-contract/SKILL.md first. This is a source-analysis instruction profile, not the historical author, a human occult expert or a fine-tuned model.

## Source identity and actual scope

- Author/attribution: Aleister Crowley
- Edition: London, 1909–1913, semi-annual — "the Review of Scientific Illuminism".
- Canonical repository record: assets/js/core/data/greatworks.js
- Existing locator(s): I:1: An Account of A∴A∴ + Liber E; I:2: Liber O vel Manus et Sagittae (1909); I:7–8: Liber Chanokh (1912)
- Reading status: inherited catalogue/passages only, unless a new task actually retrieves and reads the exact passage. This generated profile is not evidence of a new full-book reading.

## Rights and disputed claims

US PD (all ten numbers pre-1930); UK PD since 2018. Only Volume I is the safe vault — Vol. III no. 5 is The Book of Thoth (1944, NOT PD) and The Equinox of the Gods (III:3, 1936) is NOT PD in the US.

Presented as the publication vehicle that put once-secret GD material in print — the wing’s whole PD-quoting strategy rests on Volume I’s pre-1930 dates.
